falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes below 4950 on any daily candle within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern typically showed shallow, V-shaped recoveries without retests of initial lows; a break below 4950 would violate the structural floor and invalidate the 'bottom' analog, suggesting this is distribution not accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom formed with VIX peaking near 28-30 and rapidly mean-reverting; sustained VIX above 35 indicates systemic stress/escalation absent in the pattern, proving this is a different regime (credit event or geopolitical shock, not a technical washout)

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts deeper than -50bps (more negative) and holds for 3+ days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom coincided with curve steepening from deeply inverted levels; renewed aggressive inversion with equity weakness signals recession pricing, invalidating the 'soft landing correction' template and confirming this as a cyclical downturn onset

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
